raw_response: {"diagnosis":"Some transactions, apparently from batch 13 onward, carry unpadded customer_ids such as 'C8' or 'C110' instead of 'C00008' or 'C00110'. Raw transactions have 361 distinct customer_ids against 200 in the dimension, so the inner join in gold_region_daily drops those rows (4248 vs 4582), and gold_customer_spend splits customers across two ids. Padding the numeric part to 5 digits in silver_transactions fixes both.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.88,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, CASE WHEN regexp_matches(trim(customer_id), '^[Cc][0-9]+$') THEN 'C' || lpad(substr(trim(customer_id), 2), 5, '0') ELSE customer_id END AS customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
